def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits within 8 bits; the high bits wrap around to the low end."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    ex rotl8(1, 0) == 1
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(128, 1) == 1
    ex rotl8(240, 4) == 15
    ex rotl8(170, 1) == 85
    ex rotl8(255, 3) == 255
    low = x >> ((8 - k) % 8)
    high = (x & (255 >> k)) << k
    return high | low
